2608.31037.title: Language-Statistical Analysis of Neural Audio Codec Tokens Across Architectures, Corpora, and Noise Conditions
2608.31037.paper_summary: Neural audio codecs (NACs) convert speech into discrete token sequences, and prior work has reported that these sequences follow language-like statistical laws. This paper analyzes the token statistics of 13 NACs spanning multi-codebook residual vector quantization (RVQ), single-codebook VQ, and non-VQ designs, evaluated on three corpora under clean, white-noise, and real-world DEMAND-noise conditions. Zipf and Heaps parameters, unigram entropy, codebook occupancy, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) are estimated from matched token samples with explicit fit-validity safeguards and family-conditional $n$-gram orders. Corpus identity explains little variance in any metric, whereas acoustic condition and quantizer meta-category dominate in a metric-dependent way, and unigram entropy is the metric most strongly associated with meta-category. Clean-to-noise JSD computed at a common unigram order is associated with mel-cepstral distortion most clearly under DEMAND noise. The collapse and explosion degradation signatures previously reported for RVQ codecs concentrate in RVQ cells under white and DEMAND noise, respectively; explosion also occurs in non-VQ codecs, and single-codebook VQ codecs shift in occupancy and distribution shape without either signature. These results provide architecture-conditioned conventions for applying language-statistical analysis to NAC tokens.
2608.31037.paper_summary_zh: 神經音頻編解碼器（NACs）將語音轉換為離散的標記序列，先前的研究報告指出這些序列遵循類似語言的統計法則。本文分析了13種NAC的標記統計，涵蓋了多碼本殘差向量量化（RVQ）、單碼本VQ和非VQ設計，並在乾淨、白噪聲和現實世界的DEMAND噪聲條件下對三個語料庫進行評估。從匹配的標記樣本中估計Zipf和Heaps參數、單元語熵、碼本佔用率和Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD），並使用明確的擬合有效性保護措施和家庭條件的$n$-gram順序。語料庫身份在任何指標中解釋的變異性很小，而聲學條件和量化器元類別以指標依賴的方式主導，單元語熵是與元類別最強相關的指標。在DEMAND噪聲下，以共同單元語順序計算的清噪JSD與梅爾倒譜失真最明顯相關。先前報告的RVQ編解碼器的崩潰和爆炸退化特徵在白噪聲和DEMAND噪聲下分別集中在RVQ單元中；爆炸也發生在非VQ編解碼器中，而單碼本VQ編解碼器在佔用率和分佈形狀上發生變化，但沒有出現任何特徵。這些結果為將語言統計分析應用於NAC標記提供了架構條件的約定。
